subject: design/design-brainstorm-record-model
statement: A design-brainstorm record is **one markdown file per session in the shared `docs/brainstorms/` home, named `<slug>-tech-design.md`** — the class-bearing filename suffix (review ruling, 2026-07-10), the template version, and the routing pair distinguish it from its stage-1 sibling — instantiated from `design-brainstorm-record/v1`, whose typed sections extend the proven spine (routing-pair header, dense anchors, gate mechanics, freeze-at-merge) with four stage-3 organs: a **Basis** header row (the admitted requirement basis, replacing *Idea*), an **Alternatives ledger** (`ALT-n` — every candidate shape with trade-offs, principle citations, and matched incidents), a **Panel log** (one audited line per design question: seam call → fired/skipped/forced/waived → why), and a **Seam map** (`S-n` — the seams the direction opens or extends, feeding the design's Scope and Serves). Citations follow the sibling grammar as `design-brainstorm:<slug>#<anchor>`; the lifecycle is verdict-driven with one stage-3 addition — a **needs-more-product record commits on its own PR as the amendment's evidence** — and merge freezes uniformly.
